name: contract-expected-failure-cases
goal: Expected-failure runner modifiers cannot count as passing standard cases

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Discovery rejects skips and exclusive cases but treats Vitest fails modifiers as ordinary coverage. Such a modifier inverts a broken assertion into a successful runner result instead of asserting the error in the responsible case.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing scan case exercised skip and computed registration but no expected-failure modifier. Strengthen the same source matrix without adding a test declaration.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen scan case fails at6668a1271e because fails is marked enabled. Immutable proofa37651c9 retains the same two-case suite and the expected-failure assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Discovery marks fail and fails modifiers unsupported alongside skips, preserving explicit error assertions within ordinary cases. The unchanged two-case scanner suite passes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged two-case discovery suite fails expected-failure assertion at6668a1271e and passes at57f9da6ec2; paired immutable checkpoints retained with identical command and profile.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
